title_zh: 为大学运动队设定稳定训练目标

scenario.label_zh: 大学运动队的新成员训练目标
scenario.goal_zh: 明确新成员的训练困难并约定以稳定出勤和基本配合为目标

context_zh: 大学生 Dana 与队长 Lee 讨论校内排球队的新学期训练，均为成年人。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Dana
sentences.text: I’m a sophomore, but I’ve only just joined the squad. Everyone else seems much more experienced than me.

sentences.speaker: Lee
sentences.text: Experience varies. What part of practice has been hardest for you?

sentences.speaker: Dana
sentences.text: I keep trying to copy the fastest players and lose track of where I should stand.

sentences.speaker: Lee
sentences.text: For now, strive for consistent attendance and clear calls to your teammates, not spectacular moves.

sentences.speaker: Dana
sentences.text: I can do that. I’ll focus on showing up and communicating during the drills.

sentences.speaker: Lee
sentences.text: Good. We’ll review how those basics feel after a few practices.
